policyExplainer.instantModeDesc: Free slot + within your limits = confirmed instantly.
policyExplainer.manualModeDesc: Always needs admin approval, regardless of limits.
policyExplainer.perInstrumentNote: Set per instrument — check the badge before booking.
policyExplainer.fairUsageDesc: A few limits apply per member to keep instruments available for everyone. If you go over one, your request isn't blocked — it just needs admin approval instead of being confirmed automatically. Only one limit (spam prevention) blocks submission outright.
policyExplainer.noExceptions: Approved slots are never bookable by anyone else, no exceptions.
policyExplainer.outsideFeeDesc: Free in-church. Outside performances cost a per-day fee, shown on the calendar before you book.
policyExplainer.step1Desc: Mark the reservation as outside-church and agree to pay the shown fee.
policyExplainer.step2Desc: After admin review, you'll get a WhatsApp message to arrange payment & approval.
policyExplainer.hardLimitsSubtitle: Why they exist and what to do when one is reached.
policyExplainer.activeReservationsDesc: Limits how many Pending and Approved reservations a member can have at one time.
policyExplainer.activeReservationsNext: You can still submit a request. It will be sent for admin approval.
policyExplainer.reservationsPerDayDesc: Limits how many reservations a member can submit in one day to keep access fair.
policyExplainer.reservationsPerDayNext: You can still submit a request. Please wait for admin approval.
policyExplainer.durationPerReservationDesc: Limits the length of each reservation so other members can use the instrument.
policyExplainer.durationPerReservationNext: You can still submit the booking. It will be changed to manual review.
policyExplainer.sameTypeLimitDesc: Limits how many instruments from the same category a member can reserve at once.
policyExplainer.sameTypeLimitNext: You can still submit a request. Please wait for admin approval.
policyExplainer.occurrencesPerSeriesDesc: Limits how many dates can be included in one recurring reservation series.
policyExplainer.occurrencesPerSeriesNext: You can still submit the series. It will require admin approval.
policyExplainer.submissionRateDesc: Limits repeated booking submissions within a short period to prevent spam.
policyExplainer.submissionRateNext: Please wait before submitting another request.
policyExplainer.fairUsageFooter: To ensure fair usage among all users, these limits only apply to instant bookings. Exceeding any limit means your reservation will require admin approval instead of being automatically confirmed.
